Sam / Helena — thanks. I split the plan into three approval gates in the attached staging checklist: Gate A (staging readiness), Gate B (throughput & perf), Gate C (canary -> pilot scale). Each gate includes: objective, acceptance criteria, Redwood owner, Novum owner, target date, and rollback criteria.

Quick notes on acceptance criteria we propose:
- Gate A: staging VM and endpoint reachable from Novum CIDR; smoke test returns expected latencies < 120ms P50 for interactive endpoints; audit logs streaming to Novum KMS (if provided).
- Gate B: 3 consecutive throughput runs at target with <5% token error rate and no KV-cache corruption; perf report and cost estimate for steady-state.
- Gate C: 4-hour canary at 20% projected traffic with automated fallback to smaller model if latency regressions > 25%.

If Novum signs off on these gates I will create a short playbook section for on-call contacts and escalation (SLA exception path) to include with the MAP. Happy to hop on a 30-min call Thursday morning to lock the dates.

Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
